title: 第七章 外门小院立威残缺功法到手第八章 合欢堂问罪七日小比赌命
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
外门弟子的住处在鹤咏峰东侧。
比起阴暗潮湿的废丹房，这里简直像换了一个世界。
一座座小院依山而建，院中有灵泉，有聚灵阵，虽只是最低等的阵法，也比废丹房那股丹毒味强了百倍。
周荒分到的是丙三十九号院。
小院不大，却有静室、卧房，还有半亩可种灵草的空地。
他推门进去，火木双灵根便自然而然牵引周围灵气入体，那种舒畅感让他差点笑出声。
从前在废丹房，灵气少得像从破碗里抠水。
如今只是站在院中，灵气便主动往经脉里走。
周荒第一次如此清楚地明白，为什么人人都要往上爬。
资源不只是灵石丹药。
连住处，都是修行差距。
他刚把包袱放下，院门外便传来脚步声。
“谁是周荒？”
三名外门弟子大摇大摆走进来。
为首之人身材高瘦，鼻梁尖削，腰间挂着一柄黑风刀，炼气六层。身后两人一个炼气五层，一个炼气四层。
“我就是。”
高瘦男子上下打量他，眼里满是不屑。
“我叫魏世成。丙区这片院子归我照看，新来的住进来，按规矩交五块灵石孝敬费。”
周荒笑了。
“宗门发我的灵石还没捂热，你们消息倒快。”

魏世成脸色一沉。
“少废话。还有，这院子灵气不错，你一个废丹房出身不配住，搬去后面柴院，这里我替你用。”
身后两人跟着笑。
周荒看着他们，心里没有多少怒气。
比起合欢堂和废丹房，这几个外门泼皮反倒简单。
他们要灵石，要院子，要面子。
那就打掉他们的面子。
“我若不交呢？”
魏世成眼神一冷。
“那就打到你交。”
话音刚落，炼气五层弟子已一掌拍来。
周荒抬手扣住对方手腕。
咔嚓！
骨裂声响起，那弟子惨叫着被甩出院门。
剩下一人脸色大变。
魏世成瞳孔一缩。
“炼气五层巅峰？”
周荒往前一步，青红灵力在掌心交织。
魏世成拔刀。
黑风刀一出，院中卷起细碎风刃。
content_en:
The residence of the outer disciples is on the east side of Heyong Peak.
Compared to the dark and damp abandoned alchemy room, this place is like a completely different world.
Small courtyards are built against the mountains. There are spiritual springs and spirit gathering formations in the courtyards. Although they are only the lowest formations, they are still a hundred times stronger than the smell of erysipelas in the abandoned alchemy room.
Zhou Huang was assigned to Courtyard No. 39.
The small courtyard is not big, but it has a quiet room, a bedroom, and half an acre of open space for planting spiritual grass.
He pushed the door open and walked in. The two spiritual roots of fire and wood naturally drew the surrounding spiritual energy into his body. The feeling of comfort made him almost laugh out loud.
In the past, in the useless alchemy room, there was so little spiritual energy that it was like scooping water from a broken bowl.
Now just standing in the courtyard, the spiritual energy takes the initiative to flow into the meridians.
For the first time, Zhou Huang understood so clearly why everyone wanted to climb up.
Resources are not just spiritual stones and elixirs.
Even the place of residence is different in practice.
As soon as he put down the baggage, footsteps could be heard outside the courtyard door.
"Who is Zhou Huang?"
Three outer disciples walked in swaggeringly.
The leader is tall and thin, with a sharp nose, and a black wind knife hanging on his waist, with a sixth level of Qi refining. The two people behind him were at the fifth level of Qi refining and the other at the fourth level.
"I am."
The tall and thin man looked him up and down with disdain in his eyes.
"My name is Wei Shicheng. I will take care of this courtyard in Area C. Newcomers will have to pay a filial piety fee of five spiritual stones according to the rules."
Zhou Huang smiled.
"The spiritual stone sent to me by the sect has not yet been warmed up, so your news is not fast."
Wei Shicheng's face darkened.
"Stop talking nonsense. Also, this courtyard has a good aura. You are not qualified to live in a useless alchemy house. Move to the firewood courtyard behind. I will use this place for you."
The two people behind him laughed.
Zhou Huang looked at them without much anger in his heart.
Compared to the Hehuan Hall and the Waste Pill Room, these outer gate gangsters are actually simpler.
They want spiritual stones, a yard, and face.
Then destroy their face.
"What if I don't pay?"
Wei Shicheng's eyes turned cold.
"Then I'll beat you until you pay."
As soon as he finished speaking, a disciple from the fifth level of Qi Refining had already slapped him with his palm.
Zhou Huang raised his hand and grabbed the opponent's wrist.
Click!
There was a sound of cracking bones, and the disciple was thrown out of the courtyard screaming.
The expression of the remaining person changed greatly.
Wei Shicheng's pupils shrank.
"The peak of the fifth level of Qi refining?"
Zhou Huang took a step forward, green and red spiritual energy intertwined in his palms.
Wei Shicheng drew his sword.
As soon as the black wind knife came out, fine wind blades rolled up in the courtyard.
